subject: Rescheduling: Onsite demo — change in prospect travel window
messages:
From: Evan Morales <evan.morales@medisurg.com>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia@redwood.com>
Cc: Priya Shah <priya.shah@medisurg.com>
Date: Sun, 1 Aug 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Change to visit schedule — Thursday demo

Hi Sofia,

Quick heads up — our surgical team just had travel changes tied to a last-minute conference session. We still want the demo, but the on-site window we gave you for Thursday morning is now tight: two of our attendees will arrive late (flight rebooked).

Can we either shift to Thursday afternoon (2:00pm PT) or move to Friday morning? If neither works, we can do a hybrid: live demo with the core team and a recorded deep-dive for the surgeons.

Apologies for the late notice — Priya looped me in while we were on calls.

Thanks,
Evan
Principal IT Ops
MediSurg Partners
From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia@redwood.com>
To: Evan Morales <evan.morales@medisurg.com>
Cc: Priya Shah <priya.shah@medisurg.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 1 Aug 2027 10:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Change to visit schedule — Thursday demo

Hi Evan — thanks for the update and no worries.

We can do either option. Jonas, can you confirm availability for Thu 2:00pm PT or Fri 9:30am PT? If Thursday at 2pm works, we will shorten the walkthrough to the core features and record a 20-minute technical deep dive the following day for the surgeons.

Attached: onsite-demo-agenda.pdf (draft) and site-visit-map.png

Best,

> We can do either option. Jonas, can you confirm availability for Thu 2:00pm PT or Fri 9:30am PT?

Thu 2:00pm PT works for me — I'll handle the live demo flow and hit the high-impact use cases in 40 minutes. Grace, can you commit to the recorded technical deep-dive for Fri 10:30am PT? I know this is tight but it would cover the KV-cache behavior and private deployment questions Evan mentioned.

If Priya still needs the surgeons live, we can add a brief Q&A at the end and record it.

-Jonas

Notes for Evan/Priya: during the live Thu 2pm session we will prioritize:
- Inference latency and burst handling for OR workloads
- Data isolation and private deployment options overview
- Quick cost vs. accuracy trade-off demo (quantization and batching)

Then Fri recording will go deeper into caching, rollout strategies, and a short walk-through of our console tracing tools.
